terms.comment: Also care in the good sense, the attention one gives a thing.

terms.gloss: be concerned about, be anxious about
terms.grammar: phrase: labōrō with dē and the ablative
evidence: Cic. Fam. 16.4.4: nihil labōrō, nisi ut salvus sīs
terms.comment: Nihil labōrō, it doesn’t trouble me; with dē, of what one is anxious about (Lewis & Short).

evidence: Ter. Eun. 162: quid tē ergō aliud sollicitat?
Cic. Tusc. 4.18: sollicitūdō aegritūdō cum cōgitātiōne, anxiety is distress with brooding

phrases.latin: nihil labōrō, nisi ut salvus sīs
phrases.english: my only concern is that you should be well

phrases.latin: deinde eō dormītum, nōn sollicitus, mihi quod crās surgendum sit māne
phrases.english: then I go off to sleep, not worried that I have to get up early tomorrow

phrases.latin: Avia, quae dē illā domō nōn minus quam ipse labōrābat
phrases.english: Grandma, who was no less concerned about that house than he was
phrases.source: Libellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

sources: Lewis & Short: cura · Lewis & Short: laboro · Lewis & Short: sollicitus · Lewis & Short: sollicitudo
